skill.name: deployment-engineer
skill.description: Expert deployment engineer specializing in modern CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and advanced deployment automation.
skill.summary: Design secure CI/CD, GitOps, progressive delivery, rollback, and observability workflows for modern deployment teams.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static finding is a false positive. The cited line warns users to avoid production rollouts without approvals and rollback plans, which is a safety control. No semantic findings or prompt injection attempts were found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid production rollouts without approvals and rollback plans.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 32 advises against production rollouts without approvals and rollback plans. This is a deployment safety guideline, not system reconnaissance or environment enumeration.

content.value_statement: Deployment workflows can be difficult to standardize across tools, environments, and approval rules. This skill helps design secure CI/CD, GitOps, rollback, and monitoring plans.
actual_capabilities: Designs CI/CD pipeline stages with quality gates, approvals, and rollback paths.
Plans GitOps workflows for ArgoCD, Flux, Helm, Kustomize, and environment promotion.
Recommends container build, image scanning, signing, and supply chain controls.
Outlines progressive delivery patterns, including canary, blue-green, and automated rollback strategies.
Creates deployment runbook guidance with monitoring, alerting, and incident response checkpoints.
limitations: It does not run deployments or change cloud infrastructure by itself.
It requires environment details, compliance needs, and access boundaries for accurate guidance.
It cannot replace staging validation, production approvals, or expert review.
It may need adaptation for organization-specific tools and release policies.

use_cases.title: Standardize Release Pipelines
use_cases.description: Create consistent CI/CD stages, approval gates, and rollback plans for services across environments.

use_cases.title: Adopt GitOps Delivery
use_cases.description: Plan repository layouts, promotion workflows, and controller usage for Kubernetes delivery.

use_cases.title: Improve Deployment Governance
use_cases.description: Add security scanning, compliance checks, observability, and manual approvals to release workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Basic Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing release process.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current deployment workflow and suggest safer CI/CD stages, approval gates, and rollback steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design GitOps Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a GitOps workflow for Kubernetes using my environments, repository model, secrets approach, and release approval needs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Progressive Delivery
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release strategy for production services.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a progressive delivery plan with canary checks, traffic shifting, automated rollback triggers, monitoring, and operator approval points.

prompt_templates.title: Build Enterprise Governance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced deployment controls across multiple teams.
prompt_templates.prompt: Define a multi-team deployment standard with reusable pipeline templates, supply chain controls, compliance evidence, observability, and incident runbooks.

output_examples.input: Design a deployment pipeline for a containerized API.
output_examples.output: A staged release plan covering build, test, scan, sign, deploy to staging, approve production, monitor health, and roll back.

output_examples.input: Improve a Kubernetes release process with GitOps.
output_examples.output: A GitOps workflow outline with repository structure, promotion rules, secret handling, controller responsibilities, and environment-specific validation.
A control checklist with approval gates, canary metrics, alert thresholds, rollback ownership, and post-deployment verification steps.

best_practices: Provide current pipeline stages, target environments, approval requirements, and rollback expectations.
Validate recommendations in staging before using them for production releases.
Pair automation with monitoring, clear ownership, and documented incident procedures.
anti_patterns: Do not bypass production approvals because a deployment appears low risk.
Do not store secrets directly in pipeline files or application repositories.
Do not adopt progressive delivery without health metrics and rollback criteria.

faq.question: Which deployment tools does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers common CI/CD, GitOps, container, Kubernetes, infrastructure, monitoring, and security tooling patterns.

faq.question: Can it write production-ready pipeline files?
faq.answer: It can draft pipeline guidance and templates, but teams must adapt and validate them for their environment.

faq.question: Does it support GitOps workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help plan ArgoCD, Flux, repository promotion, Helm, Kustomize, and environment configuration workflows.

faq.question: Can it help with compliance controls?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest approval gates, evidence collection, scan requirements, and policy checks for release workflows.

faq.question: Does it replace deployment approval processes?
faq.answer: No. It should support approval processes, not replace required human review or organizational governance.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide environments, cloud or platform targets, tools, release frequency, risk tolerance, and rollback requirements.
